support.p:
See also [AT6DUUJJ]: 20.
Paper: heavy rice paper, in good condition, apart from fol. 1a and a butter stain at the bottom of the first 50 folios.
Black ink, with citations from the Abhisamayālaṃkāravṛtti (ID:3711) in red ink.
Extracts from other sources highlighted in blue ink.
Script: 'bru tsha.
Lines per folio: 8.
Orthographic and paleographic particularities:
- superabundant 'a chung (bde' ba, bzhi', dbye')
- palatalization in myed
- lengthening of the down stroke in letters such as ta, da, etc.
Numerous glosses and corrections by at least two different hands, in dbu med and dbu can, in particular glosses identifying the "kha cig." Some annotations without shad between words.
Illegible two lines - title (?) - in dbu can on cover page, with an annotation in dbu med underneath.
Addition by a different hand (maybe modern) after the colophon: dnyal pa zhig pos mzdad pa || dmyal tig ¦

person.persName: dge slong blo ldan shes rab
rngog dge slong blo ldan shes rab
person.note:
See [BAQ9MH4T]: 193 for the main events of his life.
Three manuscript editions of his writings and translations were deposited respectively in rNgog Blo ldan shes rab's tomb, in the monastery of gSang phu (probably in the main assembly hall), and in Drin las kyi sde (ID:4357) ([7FZ3B926]: 107).

Further holy places associated to him are: Ze thang, Grwa thang and rMog po ([647FFPZR]: 545, based on [Q3KCZX7B]: 38). Remembered for thirteen distinguished objects (such as royal insignia and religious articles), which could be objects of his clan ([4LDAV8UH]: 95.).

His dates can be approximated as 1070-1130.
He is possibly the same person as Byang 'chad khyung (ID:6382), as [NA9AMDH6] states that Khyung rin chen grags held Byang 'chad (ID:4416) and taught Sa chen (ID:4205) there ([647FFPZR]: 543). [CJ75QQKN]: 339 (fol. 8a/170a1-3). dMar ston's Zhib mo rdo rje ([RA3FK3BK]: 134 and 137), on the other hand, distinguish the two figures and places Sa chen's studies with Khyung at Nyang stod byang 'chad, and those with Khyung rin chen grags at Nyang stod.
On the reference to Khyung as "slang pa/slang pha/slang pha ba" (understood as a regionalism for "glang pa/glang pha ba," see [WL39GVT5]: 940.

person.persName: gangs pa she'u blo gros byang chub
lum pa ba ye shes byang chub
person.note:
A funerary sa 'bum was erected in 'Ban grong to house his full body (see [647FFPZR]: 544, based on [Q3KCZX7B]: 43 and 92).
Possibly identical with "dge bshes gangs pa" alias Lum pa ba Ye shes byang chub (fl. late 11th and early 12th c.) ([CCSBSVCA] : 420, n. 25).
Expert in both scholastic and tantric traditions (exX0032026-04-2303-57-49 ).

person.persName: shag kya'i dge slong byang chub ye shes
shag kya'i dge slong byang ye
a ro byang chub ye shes
person.note: Dates according to [2V6H2FBU]: 24, n. 70 ("Since Ar was invited as a dge bshes to a monastery in 1076, it is hard to believe that he was not at least 20 years old, which would put his birth-date at least in 1056. The last trace of his existence is in 1144 when he took over the head of rgyal lha khang.").

[MGPRHX73]: 58, n. 24 cites an 18th century work that argues that "gzhon nu tshul khrims" is the real name of 'Dul 'dzin dkar mo (ID:3820) and "shes rab 'bum" that of his student dKar chung ring mo (ID:3821).

person.persName: dan bag pa smra ba'i seng ge
smra ba'i seng ge dan 'bag pa
dan phag pa dar ma seng ge
smra ba'i seng ge dar 'bag pa
person.note: Part of the group of Phya pa (ID:3831)'s students referred to as the "Eight Mighty Lions." Possibly identical with (ID:6217) ([4LWBNM7B]: 106). Maybe the same person as the "Chos kyi grags pa" mentioned as lineage successor of gTsang nag pa (ID:3839) and predecessor of gNyal zhig (ID:3887) in Bu ston's lineage of the Pramāṇaviniścaya (ID:3774).

person.persName: 'u yug pa bsod nams seng ge
'u yug pa rigs pa'i seng ge
'u yug pa rig pa'i seng ge
person.note: The date of death 1253 is contested in [5632TFMN]. Van der Kuijp argues for the dating ca. 1195-after 1267. See [5632TFMN]: 333-334 for a list of his students.

person.persName: zhang ye pa 'jam dpal rdo rje
gnyal se khun pa zhang gi ya pa
person.note: Identical with (ID: 5972)?

Same person as gTsang nags phug pa 'jam dbyangs shes rab 'od zer (ID:6640)? Late 13th-early 14th c. according to van der Kuijp ([H9MPLMTV]: 22). Late 12th-early 13th c. according to [MX3PRVV2]: 3/16 and n. 4. Considered to be identical with gNyal zhig's student 'Jam dbyangs gsar ma ([4LWBNM7B]: 121). Important master in the Dro lineage of the Kālacakra ([MX3PRVV2]). A list of his compositions is discussed in [MX3PRVV2]: 7-8/16.

person.persName: gnyal zhig po 'jam pa'i rdo rje
gnyal pa zhig po 'jam pa'i rdo rje
dmyal zhig po 'jam pa'i rdo rje
yul dbus kyi slob dpon 'jam pa'i rdo rje
person.note: Fl. late 12th to early 13th c. [MPRU5QUC] records the name of this abbot as "'Jam dpal seng ge." He received the name "'jam pa'i rdo rje" during a tantric initiation ([5632TFMN]: 312 and n. 11). [AT6DUUJJ]: 23 discusses his dates, suggesting he lived towards the end of the 12th century.. [5632TFMN]: 313 suggests he may have passed away in ca. 1227.

person.persName: sa skya paN+Di ta kun dga' rgyal mtshan
rigs gter gangs can mkhas pa'i gtsug rgyan
person.note: See [8S7FDMCJ]: 107 for a list of his most important disciples.

person.persName: bo dong rin chen rtse mo
bo dong rin po che rin chen rtse mo
yul mthun pa bo dong rin rtse
slob dpon rin chen rtse mo
slob dpon rin chen rtse ba
po yul 'thun pa bo dong rin rtse
person.note: According to [2X2E3882]: 207, same person as Bo dong Sho re ba (ID: 5518). Alternative names of Bo dong rin rtse are listed in [WGRMI54Z]: 349.

person.persName: tho ston kun dga' rdo rje
person.note: 'Tho gar ba gCam lde appears to also be Tho kun dga' rdo rje, as they occupy the same position in several accounts of the Abhidharmasamuccaya lineage, see for example exX0032026-03-1209-26-28

person.persName: bcom ldan rigs pa'i ral gri
person.note: On his career, see [KHA9ZVGP]: 3-8. The dates 1227-1305 are known from the biography (see work (ID:7016)) composed by his student bSam gtan bzang po (ID:4005) ([KHA9ZVGP]: 3). His name in religion was Dar ma rgyal mtshan or Chos kyi rgyal mtshan ([FZ6N88AU]: 406) - the name Chos kyi rgyal mtshan is given as his "real name" (mtshan dngos) in a homage by Rong ston ([KM47ZZDJ]: 657 and n. 62). The majority of the colophons of his works name him "bCom ldan ral gri," a few "Rigs/Rig pa’i ral gri" or just "Ral gri." Schwabland's discussion of the variants “Rigs pa” and “Rig pa” does not come to a definite conclusion as to which is the correct spelling ([CTQMVBPR]: 2-3). He was born as the son of a local wealthy headman, the fourth of five sons and his birth is reported to have been foretold by Śākyaśrībhadra (ID:6418) when he was invited by Ral gri's paternal uncle ([KHA9ZVGP]: 3).

person.persName: bzad pa ring mo dar ma tshul khrims
gzad ring dar ma tshul khrims
zang rings grags pa dar ma tshul khrims
person.note: One of the "nine sons" of gNyal zhig (ID:3887).

person.persName: chu mig pa seng ge dpal
rtsang chu mig pa seng ge dpal bzang po
gsang phu ba seng ge dpal
rgyal ba'i sras po chu mig pa
skyel nag grags pa seng ge
snar thang grags pa seng ge
person.note: Possibly the same person as (ID:7585). [TRKXLWLA]: 354 suggests the dates: ca. 1180-1260.

person.persName: gtsang drug pa rdo rje 'od zer
gtsang drug pa rdo rje 'od zer
nyi ma sbral nag gtsang pa drug po
person.note: Argued to be identical with gNyal zhig's student gTsang pa gru gu in [4LWBNM7B]: 119-120. [TRKXLWLA]: 354 gives the dates ca. 1160-1240.

person.persName: sgam po pa bsod nams rin chen
dwags po lha rje bsod nams rin chen
mnyam med dwags po lha rje ba

person.note: One of the "nine sons" of gNyal zhig (ID:3887). Maybe identical to mKhas pa Jo nam the disciple of the rdzogs chen master Zhig po bdud rtsi (1149-1199) according to [7JUD7TIJ]: 471, n. 6.

person.persName: rgya mching ru ba shes rab dbang phyug
person.note: Fl. late 12th to early 13th c. Fourth abbot of gSang phu gling stod (ID:6172).
Contemporaneous with rGya dmar ba (ID: 3834) and sTag pa kha che (ID: 4265) ([MGPRHX73]: 54, n. 18)

person.persName: bo dong rin po che brtson 'grus rdo rje

person.note: Same person as (ID:4102)?

person.persName: mtshur ston gzhon nu seng ge
rkyang 'dur ba mtshur gzhon nu seng ge
rkyang dur ba gzhon nu seng ge
person.note: Dates ca. 1150-1210 proposed in [H9MPLMTV]: 22.
Considered to be identical with gNyal zhig's student Phu thang Dar dkon. See [Q8FCH7LF]: 294, [4LWBNM7B]: 117.

person.persName: paN+Di ta d+hi ra pA la
person.note: Indian paṇḍita. Not to be confused with three Tibetan scholars with the nickname "'Bum phrag gsum pa": (ID:6415), (ID:6416), (ID:6417). See [2X2E3882]: 252, n. 130.

person.persName: zhang ye ba smon lam tshul khrims
zhang g.ye ba smon lam tshul khrims
person.note: Likely the same person as Zhang e pa (ID:6660).

Active in the 12th century in the intellectual tradition stemming from Phya pa (ID:3831). Possibly identical with (ID: 6219), the third abbot of sPyan yas (ID:6220). See [HZARCY3E]. Possibly identical with Dan bag pa smra ba'i seng ge (ID: 3840). See [4LWBNM7B]: 106.

person.persName: gser mdog paN chen shAkya mchog ldan

person.note: Likely the same person as Zhang ye ba smon lam tshul khrims (ID:5972).

bibl.author: gnyal zhig po 'jam pa'i rdo rje
bibl.note:
Corresponds to the work listed by A khu ching, [5RXEUKD9]: 529, No. 11517. Discussed in [AT6DUUJJ], who estimates its date to be about 1200.
An instance in 521 pages preserved at Bla brang bKra shis 'khyil is mentioned by A khu Ching, see [AT6DUUJJ]: 22.
The author makes about 25 references to the views of other scholars who are not named. Some are identified in glosses in (ID:5894): 'bre (ID:3807), 'dan bag pa (ID:3840), lo tsa ba (ID:3786), gtsang nag (ID:3839), zhang ye (ID:6660)...
